fields.planned_only: automatic: always true (nothing is applied by the draft)
fields.journey: where: Connect this device -> connect_existing; This computer / Server -> new_or_local; c-ready Create a new Project -> second draft new_or_local
fields.project_mode: begin: Start a new Project / Use work that already exists (folder -> existing_local, online -> existing_online, device -> existing_local) / Restore a Project / Set up a Project later
fields.project_name: name: name field (online source: defaults to the online name)
fields.project_source_ref: ex-folder: folder picker; nas-folder: SFTP folder browser
fields.project_transport: begin > Files on another computer: nas-find method (SSH -> ssh, SMB/NFS/Already connected -> mounted)
fields.backup_transport: p-restore: backup source (Recovery Kit/folder -> local, NAS SSH -> ssh, mounted -> mounted)
fields.local_history: safe: Every version saved on this computer (on; connect journey false)
fields.online_mode: safe: Online copy row (Not now -> none, a service -> new); begin > online -> existing
fields.forge: online-service: GitHub card + Other services list
fields.forge_provider_variant: online-service: .com / self-managed / Services / Server / Cloud / Data Center / hosted Forgejo-Gitea
fields.forge_instance_profile: online-service: Forgejo/Gitea server address + Use an access token instead
fields.forge_account_action: online-signin: Sign in / Create account / already connected account row
fields.repository_visibility: online-details: Private / Public / Everyone in <org> (per service)
fields.repository_owner_scope: online-details: Whose account keeps it? (only with several)
fields.repository_container: online-details: organization / workspace / group (Azure organization, Bitbucket workspace)
fields.server_mode: where: This computer -> this_device; Server path -> new_server then existing_server after S3; connect -> existing_server
fields.server_connection_mode: c-route / s-wait: found nearby -> discover; Enter address -> manual
fields.server_ref: c-route: Puppet Master list; s-confirm: name it
fields.server_trust_confirmed: automatic: deprecated compatibility projection, set from the Server owner's pairing result, never a checkbox
fields.storage_mode: name (Server paths): On Home NAS / On this device / A network drive
fields.storage_transport: name > network drive: nas-find method (SSH, SMB, NFS, Already connected)
fields.remote_mode: c-route / away: default route + Other ways to connect
fields.remote_more: c-route / away: Other ways to connect disclosure
fields.include_vpn_networks: c-route: Also look on my VPN switch
fields.connection_pairing: c-review: Approve from a device / Enter the code / Scan its QR
fields.tailscale_control: c-route / away > Tailscale: hosted or Headscale
fields.headscale_url: c-route / away > Tailscale > Headscale address field
fields.remote_endpoint: c-route / away > Remote Link: paste the link
fields.proxy_kind: away > My own web address: Caddy default; NGINX, Traefik, NPM in Details
fields.proxy_hosting: away > My own web address: Puppet Master sets it up / Only make the settings / I already have one
fields.proxy_hostname: c-route / away > My own web address: address field
fields.proxy_tls: away > My own web address: free certificate / my own certificate
fields.source_more: begin: Use work that already exists disclosure
fields.review_confirmed: review: Create Project / Add Project / Restore Project
fields.project_draft_ref: automatic: one per draft (connect -> new Project gets its own)
fields.settings_transfer: like: Start fresh / a Project row / Choose settings (owner categories)
fields.preflight_result_refs: automatic: where check, folder check, NAS probe, repository list, name check (read-only preflight receipts)
fields.source_access_authorization_refs: automatic: selected-source sign-ins and the SSH key install
fields.project_created: automatic: always false in the draft (creation is the commit owner's receipt)

conditionals.0: like: copying settings only offered for new_or_local with a Project (hidden on later / connect)
conditionals.1: where > Connect this device: connect draft forces later, no history, no online copy, existing Server, local/VPN default
conditionals.2: begin > A folder on this computer: Continue disabled until a folder is chosen
conditionals.3: begin > Restore a Project: Continue disabled until a backup is chosen
conditionals.4: name > A network drive: Continue disabled until a folder on it is chosen
conditionals.5: safe > Online copy: Not now clears every service field
conditionals.6: safe > Online copy > a service: name + account required
conditionals.7: online-details (GitHub): Private / Public / Everyone in <org> when the org allows it
conditionals.10: online-details (Azure DevOps): privacy follows the Azure DevOps project; team project required
conditionals.12: online-details (Bitbucket Data Center): private / public / follows the project
conditionals.13: online-details (Cursor Origin): private / internal, no public
conditionals.16: away > Not now clears every remote field
conditionals.17: c-route / away > On this network / Local or VPN
conditionals.19: c-route / away > Tailscale hosted: sign in once
conditionals.21: c-route / away > My own web address: https address
conditionals.22: c-route > My own web address (connect): manual address, no proxy setup on this device
conditionals.23: c-route / away > Remote Link: paste the link
conditionals.24: online-signin: an already connected account row carries its account ref
conditionals.25: ex-online: the reviewed online Project carries its repository ref
